product.title: 10 Tastes of Amsterdam: Food Tour by UNESCO Canals and Jordaan

description.text: Eat your way around Amsterdam on this small-group food tour, with more than 10 tastings at five local eateries most visitors miss. The walk moves between De Mannen Van Kaas, the Jordaan, the UNESCO canal ring, and the Anne Frank House area, sampling stroopwafels, artisanal Gouda, and other Dutch delicacies. A local guide keeps the route on neighborhood tables rather than tourist-trap menus. The three-hour format is food-first for visitors who want canal-side tastings instead of a landmark-only circuit. Stops include De Mannen Van Kaas, Jordaan, Amsterdam Canal Ring, Anne Frank House.

highlights: Eat your way around Amsterdam on this small-group food tour
It includes over 10 delicious tastings at five local eateries that most travelers miss
